scope.game: original solo four-seat finite extensive-form game
scope.termination: playPolicyGame: stop when seat 0 is dead, at most one player remains alive, or round >= CFG.ROUNDS; an event may stop a night before auction
scope.root: all legal makeState('solo', seed-equivalent chance outcomes, picks) initializations under the frozen original CFG, with the complete support of every initialization random draw; seed 1..10000 is a measurement schedule, not the formal root universe
scope.quantification: all legal reachable histories, each player's legal observation-equivalent information sets, all legal contingent policies, and all positive-probability chance outcomes through original terminal settlement
exclusions: fixed AI or scriptedBids profiles as a substitute for player action sets
10000 seeds or any random sample as a substitute for complete chance support
one-night snapshots or hand-picked bid amounts as a substitute for the complete cross-night game
UI animation and rendering as strategic actions
post-seat-0-death continuation absent from the original solo runner
